claims.text: Many reviewers report the cream did not reduce wrinkles or lines, or had no noticeable effect even after weeks or months of use.
Several reviewers praise the cream for visibly improving wrinkles, puffiness, or dark circles around the eyes.
Some reviewers with sensitive skin or eyes say the cream is gentle and does not cause irritation or burning.
A few reviewers report negative skin reactions or dryness, including flakiness, rash, and a tight, non-moisturizing feel.
Some reviewers find the cream pleasant to apply, describing it as smooth, light, and greaseless.

qa.q: Will this eye cream help with crow's feet and fine lines?
qa.answer: Reviews report that this eye cream helps with crow's feet and wrinkles: one reviewer says their crow's feet are almost gone after a month [4], and another says it helps prevent wrinkles around the eyes [2]. However, one reviewer notes they don't have many crow's feet to judge [1], and another says they haven't started seeing fine lines [6].

claims.text: One reviewer says their crow's feet are almost gone after a month of use.
Another reviewer says the cream helps prevent wrinkles around the eyes.
One reviewer says they are blessed not to have many crow's feet, so cannot speak to that effect.
Another reviewer says they have yet to start seeing fine lines.

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin and eyes?
qa.answer: Reviews report it was tolerated by sensitive eyes and sensitive skin [1][2], though one reviewer felt the skin around the eyes was tight and stretched [5].

claims.text: A reviewer with very sensitive eyes said the cream hasn't irritated their eyes or the skin around them [1].
A reviewer with very sensitive skin was glad they tried it [2].
One reviewer reported the skin around their eyes felt tight and stretched [5].

qa.q: How long until I see results?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on timing: one user saw fine lines nearly gone and dark circles/puffiness resolved after about 4 weeks [2], while another reported no noticeable improvement after almost 1.5 months of twice-daily use [1], and a third found it useless after six months [4].

claims.text: One reviewer saw fine lines nearly gone and zero dark circles and puffiness after about 4 weeks of use.
Another reviewer reported no noticeable improvement after almost 1.5 months of twice-daily use.
A third reviewer found the product useless after six months.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it greasy or does it absorb well under makeup?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the cream as "light and greaseless" [3] and say it goes on nicely and works great under makeup [2]. No review reports it being greasy.

claims.text: The cream is described as light and greaseless.
It goes on nicely and works great under makeup.
